scope: Shared frontend model3d loader orchestration. No new backend/Go format algorithm, WASM change, renderer algorithm or peer comparison.
changes: Use native Blob snapshots for glTF in-memory buffers and images, preserving exact ArrayBuffer/view boundaries and SharedArrayBuffer-backed views. Avoid per-byte JS string construction, Base64 encoding/serialization and decoding.
Each invocation owns and releases only URLs it creates, including resolver/missing-resource/parse failures, cancellation and concurrent loads. Borrowed string URLs remain caller-owned.
Race resolver/parser waits against cancellation, observe late failures and dispose all late scenes with shared geometry/material/texture deduplication. Remove listeners after settlement.
Accept explicitly resolved HTTP URIs without a separate resourcePath. Rewrite original URIs once through a mapping so replacements cannot cascade.
Share each STEP initialization attempt across concurrent opens, clear only a failed matching attempt and cache successful initialization. Invalid STEP inputs do not reset an initialized importer.

performance.method: Fresh Chromium context for each invocation; alternating build order, seven repeats in final run. Inputs and imports ready before timing. loadMs includes glTF JSON processing, resolver normalization and complete Three.js geometry/material loading. In-memory sidecar contains only referenced positions and normals. Excludes file/network/module loading, scene helpers, renderer/GPU/paint. Complete position/normal bytes, computed bounds, material values and warnings checked after timing. Native Blob URL bookkeeping runs in both builds. No peak-memory, peer or SOTA claim. Baseline medians at or below 10 ms receive no speed claim.

browserCoverage: Actual glTF buffer, UV and PNG loading; all four visible color regions and identical complete RGBA hashes after current owned URLs are revoked
Cancellation before non-cooperative resolver completion releases prior resources and allocates no late URL
Actual late PNG response completes a cancelled glTF; geometry, material and texture each dispose once
Two real failed Emscripten WASM fetch attempts, successful STEP retry on the same library instance, subsequent importer reuse
Existing STL/GLB replacement, source cancellation, detached controls, demo STL upload and optional STEP lazy download
warnings: Existing duplicate Three.js instance warning in Vue tests
Existing large demo vendor chunk warning

limits: Same-project A/B on generated glTF geometry, not a peer/SOTA ranking or evidence for every real model. Baseline median at or below 10 ms is retained only as a control without a speed ratio.
The timer ends at complete loader resolution. Renderer/GPU/paint, external file/HTTP input transfer, module loading and peak memory are excluded. In-browser data/Blob URL handling is included.
Full geometry equivalence covers all three generated models. Pixel equivalence covers one generated two-triangle textured model, not arbitrary extensions, compressed textures or all materials.
Synchronous parsing/WASM cannot be interrupted. Asynchronous loader work may complete after cancellation; late output is disposed and rejection observed.
STEP recovery covers WASM fetch/factory initialization failures. Browser-cached JavaScript module import failures are not claimed to recover.
Existing unsupported glTF extensions and compressed-asset decoder setup are unchanged. No private camera originals or screenshots are accessed.
reproduction: Use diagnostic baselineFiles to restore the old source in an isolated checkout preserving prior changes, or reverse only model3d-resources.patch there. Never reverse it in the current workspace.
Alternatively restore diagnostic baselineRuntimeFiles at their exact repository-relative paths; the default benchmark command imports tmp/continued-review/model3d-resources-baseline/dist/index.js.
Build current with npm run build:model3d. Run node scripts/benchmark-model3d-gltf.mjs --iterations 7 --output tmp/continued-review/model3d-gltf-reproduced alone.

From packages/model3d and packages/vue, run ../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run. In the isolated old model3d source, the new test/resource-loading.spec.ts reproduces nineteen failures and two controls.
